summary: The change adds a per-card WeakMap save queue so name and group PATCH requests wait for the previous save and read the updated revision, and adds regression coverage for back-to-back saves in both orders across all three groups.

evidence: `public/admin_projects.js:28-42` defines `projectSaveQueues` and `beginProjectSave`, chaining each save to the prior save for the same card.

`public/admin_projects.js:343-345` and `430-432` await the previous queued save before sending; request bodies read `article.dataset.revision` after that wait, so the second save uses the new revision.
Successful name, origin, callback and audience saves update the card revision at `public/admin_projects.js:373` and in `applyProjectDomains`, keeping later queued saves current.
`tests/bun_test.ts:1413-1535` adds regression tests for name and group saves issued back-to-back in both orders, asserting both patch revisions apply and the final stored project and UI state match.
